primary_jobs: provide a text-bearing document without sending its contents to a cloud service
verify that Local AI is correctly configured and ready before analysis
understand and control whether RedactGuard should maintain its connection to Harnex
inspect the default RedactGuard analysis prompt and customize it when advanced extraction guidance is needed

task_model.rule: Normal product surfaces describe the user's privacy task and the consumer-safe Local AI or Harnex connection state needed to act. Harnex may be named when it gives the user a concrete connection or authorization recovery action. RedactGuard may expose its own analysis prompt because it directly controls the user's extraction task. Binder, Consumer SDK and signing-certificate mechanics remain hidden except inside progressively disclosed technical diagnostics.

information_architecture.compact_navigation: Use Android bottom NavigationBar for the three top-level destinations when the window is compact.
information_architecture.expanded_navigation: Use Android NavigationRail for the same three destinations when the window is medium or expanded and the rail improves reachability/hierarchy.
critical_journey: verify Local AI setup when needed
optional app switch and later reattachment
information_architecture.context_persistence: Non-sensitive navigation/product/job identity and the RedactGuard-owned Harnex connection preference may survive configuration changes. The user-authored analysis prompt is an explicit durable app-private preference and may contain sensitive text, so its contents must never enter logs, telemetry or saved UI state. Document text, findings, reveal state and review decisions remain process-local unless a later privacy-reviewed requirement explicitly changes this boundary.
information_architecture.destination_state_rule: Switching top-level destinations must preserve valid non-sensitive task/navigation state and must not itself activate, prepare, load, retain or switch a Local AI model.
information_architecture.external_app_switch_rule: Leaving RedactGuard while a user-initiated analysis is active detaches the visible UI as an observer; it is not an implicit cancel command. Returning must observe the same analysis job rather than starting a duplicate.

local_ai_readiness.connected: Binder/Consumer connectivity only; never present this state as sufficient analysis readiness.
local_ai_readiness.configured: An assigned use case, published preset and Host-owned binding/effective execution setup resolve without local reconstruction.
local_ai_readiness.compatible: The connected Host/Consumer contract and resolved setup are supported by this RedactGuard build.
local_ai_readiness.runtime_ready: The source-backed runtime readiness contract reports that the activated setup can execute; runtime preparation may happen only in an explicit analysis/preflight execution path, not by opening the Local AI surface.
local_ai_readiness.ready_to_analyze: A fresh fail-closed preflight confirms the setup/revisions that will be used before document content enters inference.
local_ai_readiness.inspection_side_effects: Local AI setup inspection is read-only. It must not activate a preset, prepare/load a model, create an inference session, or mutate Harnex-owned configuration.
local_ai_readiness.source_of_truth: Harnex owns and publishes the consumer-safe setup projection. RedactGuard displays it and never guesses model/configuration defaults.
local_ai_readiness.backwards_compatibility: When the connected Host does not support consumer-safe execution setup introspection, model/configuration fields are explicitly unavailable and analysis eligibility follows the versioned compatibility/preflight contract; RedactGuard never fabricates values.

harnex_connection.ownership: RedactGuard owns only the user's preference for whether this app should maintain a Harnex transport connection and the consumer-side connectivity presentation. Harnex owns application authorization, package/signing identity, use-case policy, models, presets, runtime and residency.
harnex_connection.default: Connection intent defaults to enabled so an existing valid setup behaves as before. An explicit user disconnect persists across Activity recreation and process restart until the user explicitly connects again.
harnex_connection.authorization_recovery: When Harnex is reachable but denies RedactGuard, explain that authorization is required and offer Open Harnex. RedactGuard never asks the user to copy or type a signing fingerprint; Harnex must authorize the exact source-observed package/signing identity.
harnex_connection.disconnect_semantics: Disconnect is a user-owned transport preference, not a Harnex authorization mutation. It must disable automatic reconnect and release the current Consumer connection while keeping the client reusable for a later explicit Connect.
harnex_connection.active_analysis_guard: Do not allow a Settings disconnect while a RedactGuard analysis is non-terminal. The user must complete or cancel the analysis first so a transport detach cannot masquerade as analysis cancellation.
harnex_connection.readiness_separation: A connected Harnex transport is not equivalent to configured, compatible, runtime-ready or ready-to-analyze. Direct users to AI locale for those setup/readiness details.
harnex_connection.diagnostics: Primary Settings copy remains user-facing. Stable failure codes, protocol details and signing-certificate information are expert diagnostics only and must not expose private key/certificate material.

analysis_prompt.ownership: The editable analysis guidance is RedactGuard-owned product configuration. Harnex continues to own model selection, presets, runtime policy and execution. RedactGuard's semantic finding validator remains authoritative regardless of prompt customization.
analysis_prompt.default: A robust built-in prompt is visible to the user and explicitly requires exact typeId, segmentId and surface copying, omission of selected types that are absent, no placeholder/sentinel values, an empty findings array when nothing is present, document-text prompt-injection resistance and schema-only output.
analysis_prompt.customization: Settings exposes the current prompt with a clear Default/Custom state and a single View and edit action. The editor is a dedicated full-screen mobile surface with a large text field, live bounded character count, inline validation, Cancel, Save and Reset to default. Reset changes only the draft until Save, so accidental destructive changes are recoverable.
analysis_prompt.protected_integrity: RedactGuard always appends a visible read-only protected rule set after editable guidance. Custom guidance cannot remove the requirement that typeId and segmentId are exact submitted values, surface is an exact source substring, absent types are omitted and placeholders are forbidden. Consumer-side semantic validation still fails closed on any violation.
analysis_prompt.persistence: Only a valid custom prompt is stored in app-private preferences. Absence means use the current built-in default, so users who never customize automatically receive later default-prompt improvements. Prompt contents are never logged or emitted to telemetry. The editor warns users not to paste document text, passwords or secrets into the durable preference.
analysis_prompt.job_snapshot: Starting an analysis snapshots the current prompt into that job. Editing Settings during a running analysis affects only the next analysis and must not mutate or duplicate the active job.
analysis_prompt.validation: Reject blank prompts, unsupported control characters and values above the bounded character limit before persistence or execution. Prompt length participates in capability-aware chunk planning so customization cannot silently bypass input limits.
analysis_prompt.progressive_disclosure: Settings shows a bounded readable preview and state badge by default. Full editing and exact protected rules are progressively disclosed so ordinary users benefit from the default without facing a large configuration form.

analysis_preflight.timing: Run immediately before document content can enter inference, even if a previously displayed setup looked ready.
analysis_preflight.stale_state_recovery: If setup changed after inspection, do not continue with the stale state. Explain that Local AI configuration changed, refresh the setup, and require a new valid preflight.
analysis_preflight.privacy_boundary: Do not send document text, prompt content or findings into inference before preflight succeeds.

analysis_lifecycle.job_identity: Every running analysis has one stable AnalysisJobId separate from Activity/ViewModel identity. UI surfaces observe that job rather than owning its lifetime.
analysis_lifecycle.ordinary_background: Pressing Home, switching apps, hiding the UI or recreating an Activity must not implicitly cancel an active analysis. If execution remains valid, work continues and the user returns to the same job/progress/terminal result.
analysis_lifecycle.transport_detach: A temporary Binder/observer disconnect is a transport state, not automatically a product cancellation. Reconnection reobserves the same authorized durable Harnex job when the Host contract supports it.
analysis_lifecycle.settings_disconnect: An explicit Settings disconnect is persisted and suppresses lifecycle auto-reconnect, but is rejected while a non-terminal analysis is owned by RedactGuard. It does not revoke Harnex authorization or silently cancel work.
analysis_lifecycle.explicit_cancel: Only an explicit user/product cancellation or a documented terminal resource/runtime condition ends the job as Cancelled/Interrupted.
analysis_lifecycle.harnex_process_loss: If the Harnex process dies, native model/session/decode memory is considered lost. The analysis becomes interrupted with a truthful recoverable reason and may restart only from a documented safe boundary after setup is rediscovered.
analysis_lifecycle.redactguard_process_loss: Process-local sensitive analysis state is not silently persisted or reconstructed. Recovery is source-class aware; pasted text is not transparently resumable under the current privacy boundary.
analysis_lifecycle.critical_pressure: Critical memory/resource pressure may interrupt active work for system health. Surface the reason distinctly from generic connectivity and offer only a valid recovery action.
analysis_lifecycle.notification: When Android requires foreground execution for a long user-initiated analysis, the execution owner must provide a truthful ongoing notification with progress/status that is actually known and an explicit cancel action when supported. Avoid duplicate uncoordinated notifications across RedactGuard and Harnex.
analysis_lifecycle.no_duplicate_execution: Lifecycle restoration, reconnect, retry presentation and navigation must never silently start a second inference job while the original job is still active or has a queryable terminal result.

secondary: Perform an explicit recovery action when blocked

defaults.local_ai_setup_refresh: explicit or lifecycle-safe refresh; never activation as a side effect of navigation
defaults.harnex_explicit_disconnect: persist across Activity/process recreation and suppress automatic reconnect until explicit Connect
defaults.analysis_prompt_mode: built-in robust default unless the user explicitly saves a valid custom prompt
defaults.analysis_prompt_integrity_rules: always appended, visible on demand and never editable
defaults.analysis_prompt_reset: changes the editor draft first and becomes durable only on Save
defaults.single_available_runtime_preset: auto-select and hide selector when selection has no product value, while keeping the active preset visible in setup details
defaults.background_analysis: continue a valid user-initiated active job across ordinary app switching; do not equate background visibility with cancellation
defaults.process_loss_recovery: fail truthfully and recover from an approved safe boundary; never claim transparent native-state preservation
defaults.export_eligibility: disabled until all required review decisions are valid
defaults.unsupported_image_only_pdf: fail explicitly with recovery guidance; never invoke OCR implicitly

feedback_and_recovery.interaction_contract: Every meaningful action follows action -> acknowledgement -> truthful progress/status -> outcome -> next action or recovery.
feedback_and_recovery.analysis_progress: Expose real phases that the application can truthfully know; never fabricate percentage progress.
feedback_and_recovery.background_continuity: If analysis continues while the UI is not visible, returning to RedactGuard must show the same job and latest truthful progress/result. Do not present the app switch itself as an error.
feedback_and_recovery.reattachment: Temporary transport/UI detachment is shown only when it affects user action. Reattachment must not duplicate generation or discard a queryable terminal result.
feedback_and_recovery.process_loss: Differentiate RedactGuard process loss, Harnex process loss and critical resource interruption when known. Explain that in-memory execution cannot be presumed to survive and offer the source-appropriate safe recovery action.
feedback_and_recovery.harnex_connection: Distinguish explicit user disconnect, transient disconnect, Harnex not installed, authorization required and incompatible Host. Connect/retry changes only RedactGuard connection intent; Open Harnex is the recovery route for Host-owned authorization/configuration. Do not ask users to manage package signing fingerprints.
feedback_and_recovery.analysis_prompt: Reject invalid drafts inline before Save, preserve the previous saved prompt on Cancel or validation failure, make Reset reversible until Save, and show Default/Custom state after the change. Explain that edits apply only to future analyses.
feedback_and_recovery.setup_status: Distinguish connectivity, configuration, compatibility, runtime readiness and final analysis readiness. Never collapse them into a generic connected state.
feedback_and_recovery.setup_change: When the setup/revision changes between inspection and Analyze, refresh the consumer-safe projection, explain that configuration changed, and require a new valid preflight.
feedback_and_recovery.error_contract: State what failed, why or which constraint was hit when known, whether user content was modified, and the next recovery action.
feedback_and_recovery.partial_results: Analysis remains atomic. If any required chunk fails, partial findings are not exposed as a valid review result.
feedback_and_recovery.cancellation: User-initiated cancellation is a normal lifecycle outcome and returns to a recoverable product state rather than being presented as an unexplained failure.

accessibility.target: Android-native accessibility behavior aligned to WCAG 2.2 AA where applicable

rules: Preserve content and action priority instead of uniformly stretching a phone column.
Use NavigationBar for compact top-level navigation and NavigationRail when medium/expanded width makes that hierarchy more usable.
Use a dedicated near-full-screen prompt editor on compact Android windows so long-form editing, the keyboard, validation and Save/Cancel remain usable without a cramped dialog.
Use additional width to keep task context visible during review where this improves comprehension.
Primary actions remain reachable without horizontal scrolling.
Sensitive values never become permanently visible merely because more space is available.
Do not invent the approved reference's summary rail until truthful document/category summary projections exist.

critical_journeys.name: Paste text -> choose protection -> fresh Local AI preflight -> local analysis -> review -> export
Import text PDF -> choose protection -> fresh Local AI preflight -> local analysis -> review -> export -> reopen verification
Open AI locale -> inspect setup/readiness -> technical details when needed -> return without activation/preparation side effects

Open Settings -> inspect Harnex connection -> explicit disconnect persists without auto-reconnect -> explicit connect/retry -> authorization recovery opens Harnex -> connected state without duplicating Host administration

Open Settings -> see default prompt -> open editor -> save valid custom guidance -> observe Custom state -> reopen -> reset draft -> save -> return to Default while protected rules remain visible and immutable
Analysis active -> press Home or switch app -> analysis continues -> return -> same job/progress/result without duplicate inference
Analysis active -> Harnex process loss or critical pressure -> structured interruption -> safe source/setup-aware recovery without pretending the old native session survived
Previously ready setup changes -> Analyze performs fresh preflight -> stale setup is blocked -> refreshed setup/recovery is shown
Local AI unavailable or authorization required -> actionable state -> Host/authorization becomes available -> retry succeeds
Known document failure -> specific explanation -> safe recovery
Analysis in progress -> cancel -> cleanup -> recoverable pre-analysis state

validation.accessibility_automation: RTA-9: Compose UI/instrumentation semantics and accessibility checks
validation.visual_regression: RTA-9: selective stable-surface screenshot regression where valuable
validation.manual_accessibility: RTA-9: representative physical-device TalkBack, large-text and touch-target review
validation.usability_evidence: Review critical journeys against this contract before release; record deviations as bounded issues/workstreams
validation.analysis_prompt_evidence: Prompt policy unit tests prove robust default and protected rules; planner/runtime tests prove prompt snapshot and capability budgeting; Android UI evidence proves default visibility, customization, inline validation, reset recovery and Default/Custom state without exposing prompt contents to logs. Material integration evidence captures the Settings editor in representative compact/adaptive contexts.
validation.local_ai_setup_evidence: LAS: prove read-only inspection has no activation/preparation side effects, fresh preflight fails closed on stale/incompatible setup, displayed setup agrees with execution snapshot, ordinary app-switch does not cancel a valid active job, reattachment does not duplicate inference, and process/resource interruption is surfaced truthfully.
validation.harnex_connection_evidence: Use exact-candidate independent-signer E2E to prove Consumer-before-Host installation retains the normal bind capability, first connection is denied until explicit Harnex authorization, authorized connect/disconnect/reconnect works, explicit disconnect persists without lifecycle reconnect, and a replacement signer cannot inherit prior authorization. The Settings journey requires full-media evidence because navigation, state progression and recovery actions are part of the claim.
